26:160.text: (-who dwelt in the town of Sodom in Palestine)

26:161.text: said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26:162.text: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26:163.text: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26:164.text: "No reward do I ask of you for it
; my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:165.text: "Go you in unto the males of the ‘Âlamîn

26:166.text: "And leave those whom Allâh has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people!"

26:167.text: They said: "If you cease not O Lût
! verily, you will be one of those who are driven out!"

26:168.text: He said: "I am, indeed, of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your

26:169.text: "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do."

26:170.text: So We saved him and his family, all,

26:172.text: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

26:173.text: And We rained on them a rain
. And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!

26:174.text: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26:175.text: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26:177.text: When Shu‘aib said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh

26:178.text: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26:179.text: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26:180.text: "No reward do I ask of you for it
; my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn

26:181.text: "Give full measure, and cause no loss

26:182.text: "And weigh with the true and straight balance.

26:183.text: "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land.
